# dgrid_from_atoms_aabb_rust { #mofography.rust_fun.dgrid_from_atoms_aabb_rust }

```python
rust_fun.dgrid_from_atoms_aabb_rust(
    ase_atoms,
    spacing,
    radii=None,
    n_neighbors=10,
)
```

Compute a distance grid using the Rust AABB/PBC neighbor search backend.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Default    |
|-------------|-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ase_atoms   | ase.Atoms             | ASE Atoms object containing the atomic structure                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | _required_ |
| spacing     | float                 | Grid spacing in Angstroms                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | _required_ |
| radii       | numpy.ndarray \| None | Van der Waals radii for each atom. If None, uses Bondi (1964) handbook radii with Mendeleev fill for undefined symbols (:func:`~mofography.vdw_radii.default_vdw_radii_angstrom`). Pass ``mendeleev_vdw_radii_angstrom(atoms)`` for the legacy Mendeleev-only table. | `None`     |
| n_neighbors | int                   | Number of nearest neighbors to query from the AABB tree, defaults to 10                                                                                                                                                                                              | `10`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type          | Description                                                        |
|--------|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | numpy.ndarray | 3D distance grid where values represent distances to atom surfaces |
